inj.note: After opening the week with back-to-back missed practices, Henry's designation leaves the door open for him to play heading into Sunday. If he can't play, New England would need to lean more heavily on rookie Eli Raridon at tight end against Green Bay.

news.h: Hunter Henry hopeful to play after limited practice Friday
news.d: Report on TE Hunter Henry being listed as questionable ahead of the Patriots' Week 9 matchup against the Packers.
